exposure: Vaginal microbiota changes (bacterial density, diversity, dominant bacteria, pH, Nugent score, microbiota classification: normal flora, flora inhibition, vulvovaginal candidiasis, bacterial vaginosis, bacterial vaginosis + vulvovaginal candidiasis, dysbacteria)
cohort: The study enrolled 80 healthy Chinese women of childbearing age.
finding: Vaginal microbiota in Chinese women undergoes dynamic changes during gestation, with significant differences in vaginal pH, diversity/density, dominant bacteria, and Nugent score across five time points, but the state of vaginal microbiota (normal vs. dysbiosis) was not related to pregnancy and newborn outcomes.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in cesarean section rates between the normal and dysbiosis vaginal microbiota groups.
